name: Sa Calobra (Coll dels Reis)
summary: Ride Sa Calobra in Mallorca’s Serra de Tramuntana: a demanding climb from the coast towards Coll dels Reis. This GPX covers 10.1 km and approximately 677 m of ascent.
tip: The download is the climb only. If you ride down to the coast first, include that descent and your approach in your day's plan. Pace the ascent and carry enough water.

name: Cap de Formentor
summary: Explore the Cap de Formentor lighthouse ride in northern Mallorca. This 48.9 km GPX includes the Pollença Bay approach, the ride through Port de Pollença and the return from the lighthouse.
tip: Allow for climbing on the return as well as the outward leg. Check current official road access notices before travelling; no fixed access dates are assumed here.

name: Puig Major from Sóller
summary: Climb from Sóller towards the Monnàber tunnel on the Puig Major road. This 17.1 km GPX follows a public-road climb in the Serra de Tramuntana, not a route to the restricted mountain summit.
tip: Plan your return or onward route separately: this download is a one-way climb. The restricted summit is not part of the ride.

name: Coll de Sóller
summary: Discover Coll de Sóller, the old mountain pass between the Palma side of Mallorca and the Sóller valley. The current download is a schematic illustration, not a road-following navigation track.
tip: Use a verified road-following track before navigating this pass. The current file's metadata says 7.5 km, but its 16 straight-line points total about 4.1 km; neither provides a reliable navigable course.

name: Andratx → Port de Pollença
summary: Cross the Serra de Tramuntana from Andratx to Port de Pollença on a 114.0 km road cycling route. This point-to-point GPX includes approximately 2,435 m of recorded ascent.
tip: Arrange a return transfer or a separate return ride. The GPX finishes at Port de Pollença rather than central Pollença, so plan your pickup accordingly.

name: Calvià Loop
summary: Explore southwest Mallorca on the Around Calvia GPX: a 55.3 km road cycling loop starting and finishing near Magaluf, with approximately 982 m of recorded ascent.
tip: This is the 55.3 km Around Calvia loop, not the longer Calvia coast to coast route. Recorded elevation includes GPS noise, so climbing totals are approximate.
